metadata.source: European Commission, Joint Research Centre, PVGIS 5.3
metadata.method: Grid-centre sample at 0.5 degrees; 0.25 degrees when fewer than 5 points. Within each region weights are proportional to cos(latitude). Nearest 10 kWh/kWp/year. Trento and Bolzano combined before averaging. Approximate spatial benchmark, not roof- or population-weighted.
